comment: Bridge SVP. pokemontcg.io ships an svp set (ptcgo_code 'PR-SV', name 'Scarlet & Violet Black Star Promos'), but neither its abbreviation nor its normalized name matches TCGCSV's 'SVP' / 'SV: Scarlet & Violet Promo Cards'. The auto-linker can't bridge them, so the link has to be supplied explicitly.

Synthesize MEP. pokemontcg.io has not yet published a Mega Evolution Promo set (~8 months past TCGCSV's release on 2025-09-26 as of 2026-05-24). Building the set row from TCGCSV's group metadata lets the 83 known MEP printings show up in /browse without waiting on upstream. If pokemontcg.io eventually adds a competing set entry, drop the synthesize block and keep this as a plain bridge.
